---
title: "Recurrentes"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header">
  <div><h1>Movimientos recurrentes</h1><div class="tf-muted">Ingresos y pagos previstos que alimentan el Plan mensual y se contabilizan únicamente cuando los registras.</div></div>
  <div class="tf-actions"><button id="rec-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">+ Nuevo recurrente</button><button id="rec-archived-toggle" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button" hidden>Archivados</button><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button></div>
</div>

<section class="tf-card">
  <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><h2 id="rec-list-title">Recurrentes activos</h2><div class="tf-muted">Registrar no cambia de pantalla: abre Movimientos con los datos del recurrente ya llenados.</div></div></div>
  <div class="tf-table-wrap"><table class="tf-table tf-recurring-table"><thead><tr><th>Nombre</th><th>Tipo</th><th class="tf-num">Cantidad</th><th>Fecha</th><th>Estado</th><th>Registrar</th><th>Información</th></tr></thead><tbody id="rec-list"></tbody></table></div>
  <div id="rec-empty" class="tf-empty" hidden></div>
</section>

<dialog id="rec-editor" class="tf-modal-dialog tf-budget-editor-dialog">
  <div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Recurrente</div><h2 id="rec-editor-title">Nuevo recurrente</h2></div><button id="rec-editor-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary tf-btn-compact" type="button">Cerrar</button></div>
  <form id="rec-form" class="tf-budget-editor-form">
    <div class="tf-budget-editor-scroll">
      <div class="tf-form-grid">
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Nombre</label><input id="rec-name" required></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="rec-type"><option value="expense">Egreso</option><option value="income">Ingreso</option></select></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Monto estimado ($)</label><input id="rec-amount" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" required></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta habitual (opcional)</label><select id="rec-account"></select></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Categoría</label><select id="rec-category"></select></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Subcategoría</label><select id="rec-subcategory"></select></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Día del mes</label><input id="rec-day" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="1" max="31" value="1"></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Recordar (días antes)</label><input id="rec-reminder" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="0" max="30" value="3"></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Desde</label><input id="rec-start" type="date"></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Hasta (opcional)</label><input id="rec-end" type="date"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tf-budget-save-bar"><button id="rec-cancel" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cancelar</button><button id="rec-submit" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="submit">Guardar recurrente</button></div>
  </form>
</dialog>

<dialog id="rec-register-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog tf-tx-editor-dialog">
  <div class="tf-modal-head tf-tx-editor-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Movimiento recurrente</div><h2 id="rec-register-title">Registrar pago recurrente</h2></div><button id="rec-register-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary tf-btn-compact" type="button">Cerrar</button></div>
  <form id="rec-register-form" class="tf-tx-quick-form">
    <div class="tf-tx-static-pane">
      <div class="tf-tx-type-switch"><button id="rec-register-type" type="button" class="tf-tx-type-btn is-active" disabled>Gasto</button></div>
      <div class="tf-tx-amount-block"><label for="rec-register-amount">Monto</label><div class="tf-tx-amount-input-wrap"><span>$</span><input id="rec-register-amount" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" required></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tf-tx-details-scroll">
      <div class="tf-tx-details-title"><strong>Detalles del movimiento</strong><span>La información viene del recurrente y puede ajustarse antes de guardar.</span></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta</label><select id="rec-register-account"></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Categoría y subcategoría</label><button id="rec-register-category-picker" type="button" class="tf-tx-category-picker">Seleccionar categoría y subcategoría</button><input id="rec-register-category" type="hidden"><input id="rec-register-subcategory" type="hidden"></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Descripción</label><input id="rec-register-description" autocomplete="off"></div>
      <div class="tf-form-grid tf-tx-date-time-grid">
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="rec-register-date" type="date" required></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Hora</label><input id="rec-register-time" type="time"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tf-tx-save-bar"><div class="tf-actions tf-tx-normal-actions"><button id="rec-register-cancel" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cancelar</button><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="submit">Guardar movimiento</button></div></div>
  </form>
</dialog>

<dialog id="rec-register-category-dialog" class="tf-tx-category-dialog">
  <div class="tf-tx-category-dialog-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Movimiento</div><h3 id="rec-register-category-title">Seleccionar categoría</h3></div><button id="rec-register-category-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div>
  <div id="rec-register-category-body" class="tf-tx-category-options"></div>
</dialog>

<dialog id="rec-detail-dialog" class="tf-tx-category-dialog">
  <div class="tf-tx-category-dialog-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Recurrente</div><h3 id="rec-detail-title">Información</h3></div><button id="rec-detail-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div>
  <div id="rec-detail-body"></div>
</dialog>

<script type="module" src="js/recurring.js?v=1.0.85"></script>
```
